page.title: Kvisko — Little questions, big discoveries
page.description: Little questions. Big discoveries. A fun picture quiz for curious children.
nav.tagline: A little more curious every day
home.intro.first: A whole world is waiting, one picture at a time.
home.intro.second: Choose a quiz and set off on an adventure.
home.footnote: A little play. A lot to discover.
home.gentle: No rush or pressure. Every answer is a discovery.
quiz.world-flags.title: World flags
card.world-flags.description:
So many colours. So many places.
Can you recognise this flag?
quiz.animals.title: Animals
card.animals.description:
From cats to elephants, forests to savannas.
Who is hiding in the picture?
quiz.plants.title: Fruit, vegetables and plants
card.plants.description:
What grows in gardens, fields and the wild?
Look at the picture and find out!
quiz.dog-breeds.title: Dog breeds
card.dog-breeds.description:
Big, small, fluffy and short-haired.
Meet your new friend and guess the breed!
quiz.traffic-signs.title: Road signs
card.traffic-signs.description:
Signs, traffic lights and crossings.
Recognise the things you see on the street!
quiz.sports.title: Sports
card.sports.description:
On the field, in the snow or in the water.
Look at the athletes and guess the sport!
quiz.shapes-colours.title: Shapes and colours
card.shapes-colours.description:
A red triangle, a blue circle, a green cube.
Recognise the shape and its colour!

credits.title: Photos and sources
credits.intro: Thank you to the photographers helping us discover animals, plants and sports! Photos come from Wikimedia Commons. Authors, source files and licences are listed below. Images were downloaded at a smaller resolution and appear in questions without further cropping or editing. Quiz labels are adapted for children. Road signs are original SVG illustrations from Wikimedia Commons; the traffic lights and zebra crossing were drawn by Kvisko’s authors and released under CC0. The coloured shapes are original Kvisko illustrations under GPL-3.0-only.
